items.title: Phil Woods interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: I did Phoebe Snow’s overdub and Billy Joel in the same day — the same half hour.

ctx.x: And you’ve had your forays into the pop field as a soloist, with Billy Joel—
Yeah Billy Joel, I did Paul Simon “Still Crazy After All These Years,” Phoebe Snow, a couple of others that elude me at the moment.
Can you recall when you did the thing on “Just the Way You Are,” how many takes did you get on that?

items.title: Phil Woods — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he got me the gig with uh with Billy Joel. “Just the Way You Are.”

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah … whatever. I need a break. [Recording stopped]

What was the first one I did? I was a good friend of Phil Ramone’s and he got me the gig with uh with Billy Joel. “Just the Way You Are.” And Phoebe Snow, I did Phoebe Snow and Billy Joel in the same session. It was just me and Phil in the studio and he had the changes on the back of a matchbook cover, you know. And the Billy Joel thing is like a pop song, and Phoebe Snow was okay. And he got me an Aretha Franklin … [sings da da da da]
